latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Handyman Video skill

- Helps handyman services create short, trust-building service videos.
- Guides users to specify video type (overview, trade capability, reliability, project showcase, testimonial).
- Collects key details: trades, licensing, service area, booking, typical projects, and reliability factors.
- Generates concise scripts (45–75 seconds) highlighting reliability, craftsmanship, and transparent pricing.
- Suggests effective video formats: repair in action, customer quotes, before/after, or service range demonstrations.
